tool_args.rationale: The current five observations show monotone concave response and sink-gradient dependence, but all are at one horizon and below the suspected avalanche threshold. A high-sgrad regime measurement is the targeted probe needed to test for a threshold-triggered downturn.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche siphon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Existing s_grad values top out at 2.44, below the expected critical region around 2.50–2.68; avalanche contribution is not identified.
Those rows target coupled memory ODE identification, while the observed signatures and near-threshold gradient suggest a cheaper, more relevant high-gradient probe.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms and is explicitly not worth its cost.
